mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses equity discount rates through lower risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
